items.title: 27.3.1 Enzyme activity par asar dalne wale factors (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the factors affecting enzyme activity (PDF 168).

blocks.text: Enzyme ki activity par asar dalne wale ahem factors (wajoohat) yeh hain: temperature, pH, aur substrate aur enzyme ki concentration (kisi cheez ki miqdar fi volume) mein tabdeeli. Kuch doosre substances (maadde), jaise co-enzymes, activators aur inhibitors, bhi enzyme ke kaam par asar dalte hain.

Temperature aur pH: jis temperature aur pH par enzyme sab se zyada kaam kare unhein optimum temperature aur optimum pH kehte hain. Agar temperature ya pH in optimum values (behtareen qeematon) se hat jaye to enzyme ka kaam ruk sakta hai, kyun ke us ki shakal bigar jati hai. Insani jism aur doosre jaandaron mein enzyme reactions taqreeban 37 °C aur 6.4-6.9 pH par sab se achhi hoti hain. (Kuch enzymes, jaise maide (stomach) ka pepsin, is se bohat mukhtalif pH par behtareen kaam karte hain.)

Enzyme aur substrate ki concentration: enzyme ya substrate ki concentration barhane se reaction ka rate (raftaar) barhta hai, kyun ke zyada molecules hone se jurne ki jagahein bhi zyada hoti hain aur zyada enzyme-substrate complex banta hai. Lekin substrate ko aik had se zyada barhane par rate aur nahi barhta; kitab kehti hai ke reaction slow (sust) bhi ho sakta hai, kyun ke active sites pehle se bhari hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Teen graph: temperature ke saath reaction ka rate optimum (taqreeban 37 °C) tak dheere dheere barhti aur us ke baad tezi se girti hai; pH ke saath rate optimum pH (6.4-6.9) par sab se zyada; substrate concentration barhne par rate barhta aur phir seedha (flat) ho jata hai.
blocks.caption: Temperature, pH aur substrate concentration enzyme activity par kaise asar karte hain (is topic ke liye hamari drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bohat garmi ya ghalat pH enzyme (protein) ki shakal bigar deta hai, is liye active site kaam nahi karti; optimum se oopar rate tezi se girta hai. Zyada substrate se rate sirf tab tak barhta hai jab tak active sites bhar na jayein.

blocks.prompt: Zyada temperature par enzyme kaam karna kyun chhor deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Garmi us ki 3D shakal thaamne wale bonds tor deti hai, is liye active site ki shakal badal jati hai (enzyme denature ho jata hai) aur substrate fit nahi hota.

items: Optimum temperature (insaanon mein taqreeban 37 °C) aur optimum pH par enzyme sab se tez.
Zyada enzyme ya substrate: rate barhta hai, jab tak active sites bhar na jayein.
Co-enzymes, activators aur inhibitors bhi asar dalte hain.
